_comment: Opt-in supporter recognition shown in Seedbed's About page. Add a { "name": "…" } entry (optionally "url") only when someone asks to be listed, then redeploy with Scripts/publish-site.sh — no app release needed. Seedbed fetches https://seedbed.dev/supporters.json when the About page opens, caches the last good copy, and hides the section entirely when this list is empty.
